description: Use when you need who holds a token (concentration, whales, treasury): returns the top N holders of an ERC-20 contract on Base or Ethereum with rank, checksummed address, raw and formatted balance, and share of total supply when the explorer provides it. Public name tags and ENS from the explorer are included as labels; no personal identity is invented and emails are stripped. Ethereum prefers Blockscout, falls back to Ethplorer. Base uses Blockscout; if that explorer blocks the request, the call returns 503 and is not charged. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

address.description: Token contract address (0x…) on the chosen chain. Example: USDT on Ethereum (use with chain=ethereum).

chain.description: Chain. The example address is on Ethereum, so it needs chain=ethereum.
